The www.inceptron.io/models page shows partly different list prices (GLM 5.3 $1.40/$4.40, GLM 5.2 $1.20/$4.20, Kimi K2.7 Code $0.75/$3.50, Kimi K2.6 $0.73/$3.50, DeepSeek V4 Flash $0.13/$0.28); MiniMax M2.5 is gone from both the web page and the API. None of the other newest frontier models (Kimi K3, MiniMax M3, Qwen3.8 Max, GLM-5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro) offered. HQ Sweden (SE), datacenter Finland (FI) per OpenRouter provider metadata.
